title: Learning to Plan & Reason for Evaluation with Thinking-LLM-as-a-Judge
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research. The study concentrates on a general framework for LLM-as-a-Judge models to plan and reason during evaluation tasks across general domains like chat, safety, code, and math.
